questions.q: A user has full record-level access to an Account through OWD, role hierarchy, and a sharing rule. Can field-level security still hide a specific field on that record from them?
options: Yes, FLS is independent of record access and can still hide specific fields
No, record-level access always overrides field-level security
Only if the field is a formula field
Only if the OWD is set to Private
questions.explain: Record access and field-level security are independent layers; a user can see a record and still be blocked from specific fields on it by FLS.

questions.q: Why is FLS described as a 'flat' access model compared to role hierarchy or sharing rules?
options: Because it only applies to formula fields
Because it is configured only through Apex, never declaratively
Because it cannot be combined with permission sets
Because a field's visibility is the same across every record of that object for a given profile/permission set, with no hierarchy or per-record exception layer
questions.explain: Unlike sharing, which varies by record and cascades through hierarchy, FLS applies uniformly across every record of the object for a given profile or permission set.

questions.q: Per this lesson's architectural guidance, what should be the primary, day-to-day lever for managing field access as an org scales?
options: Profile-level FLS edits on every profile
Page layout changes
Permission sets / permission set groups
Restriction rules
questions.explain: Permission sets are additive, composable, and auditable per-grant, making them easier to maintain and explain than edits buried in a growing profile.

questions.q: A field is added to a page layout, but a specific profile still can't see it on the record page, with no error shown. What's the most likely cause?
options: The record's OWD is set to Private
The field is hidden for that profile by field-level security
The user lacks the 'View All' permission on the object
The page layout was deleted
questions.explain: This is the classic FLS-versus-layout trap: being on the layout only controls arrangement, not visibility — FLS silently hides the field if it's set to Hidden for that profile.

questions.q: Which Setup screen gives the fastest answer to 'what is every profile's effective access to this one field, right now'?
options: Page Layout Editor
Setup Audit Trail
View Field Accessibility
Background Jobs
questions.explain: View Field Accessibility summarizes effective access across every profile for a given field in one screen, rather than checking profiles one at a time.
